verdict.rationale: Mastra provides the building blocks (agents that reason over data, tools to query APIs/databases, structured output, live evals/scorers) that a developer could use to generate AI-driven insights and suggestions, but Mastra itself is a framework, not an end-user product surfacing insights from 'my data' — the closest first-party UI is Studio, which shows traces/runs rather than data-derived insights. missing for 10: evidence of a built-in end-user-facing insights/suggestions feature over the user's own data, and independent confirmation such a feature works in practice.
